panels.rationale: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT from a confirmed paragonimiasis case (article title and in-text confirm paragonimiasis manifesting as pulmonary nodule). The image shows a right lower lobe subpleural solid irregular nodule with broad pleural attachment, pleural tags, and adjacent pleural/extrapleural fat thickening—consistent with pulmonary paragonimiasis presenting as a solid nodule with subpleural worm-track features. This is a recognized but less common CT presentation compared to the classic ring shadow/cyst, hence variant typicality. No ring shadow is clearly depicted; the dominant finding is a solid subpleural nodule which is not directly in the vocabulary and is therefore proposed. [raw subtype: pulmonary_paragonimiasis]
